Notes: Every call cites native sequence and request ID. SDK operations remain SDK; Raw is only malformed ABAC wire. Account and owned bucket names are rebound.

Native Tags and TagSet ordering is retained verbatim, not asserted to be an AWS ordering guarantee. Their API semantic contract is a set; integration should compare those two fields as sets rather than implement observed hash iteration order.

Archive-only exclusions are explicit: SDK validation, capture signing omissions, repeated native InternalError duplicate create/untag ambiguity, transient post-removal quota errors. They are not reinterpreted as stable successes.

LastModified is bound from native pre-toggle HeadObject and subsequent reads require equality; object plaintext and metadata are compared. Reopen flags reconstruct local persistence checks, not extra AWS observations.
Native CloudTrail history records with complete field presence and request correlation are retained in evidence AuditLookup; no paid trail or delivery expectation was fabricated.
GetObject ChecksumMode is projected from the actual native x-amz-checksum-mode request header; botocore supplied it automatically. Plaintext retains the shared replay base64 byte representation.

ExcludedObservations.52: capture signing omission, not ABAC behavior
